title: Letterhead
slide_intent: Teach designers to distinguish the reading side of correspondence from the side that identifies the sender at a glance.
strategic_value: Sheffield Museums can make a routine letter recognizable while preserving space for the recipient’s message.
demonstration: Two pale portrait sheets sit side by side. A small pink seal and venue list frame the written letter on the first. A much larger pink seal occupies the reverse.
practical_value: Use the smaller seal and quieter identifiers on the writing side. Use the reverse when the seal itself is the message.

content_islands.name: Letter face
content_islands.spec: Set the seal at upper left and the venue list opposite. Group the date, reference, salutation, paragraphs and sign-off beneath with a compact contact block at the foot.

content_islands.name: Reverse
content_islands.spec: Match the size of the first sheet and leave a narrow gutter. Center the enlarged pink seal in the open field.
